name: WebP Image Converter XD
author: Muhammad Ali Khizar

sections.description:
WebP Image Converter XD is a WordPress plugin designed to enhance your website’s performance by converting images to the modern WebP format. This high-efficiency image format provides smaller file sizes without compromising visual quality, resulting in faster loading times and smoother user experiences. Additionally, the plugin allows direct uploads of WebP images and automatically handles file naming conflicts.

Features

  • Automatic Image Conversion: Automatically converts uploaded images to WebP format, optimizing your media library.
  • WebP Upload Support: Upload WebP images directly to your WordPress site without any issues.
  • Duplicate File Handling: Automatically renames files with duplicate names by appending a number to ensure uniqueness (e.g., image-1.webp, image-2.webp).
  • Quality Control: Easily adjust the quality of the converted WebP images (default set to 85).

Usage

  • Upload Images: Simply upload your images through the WordPress media uploader. All supported formats will be automatically converted to WebP upon upload.
  • Upload WebP Files: You can also upload WebP files directly without any issues.

Compatibility

  • Tested with WordPress versions 5.0 and above.
  • Compatible with most themes and other plugins that utilize the WordPress media uploader.

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit the Xpert Dezine IT Facebook Page or open an issue in the plugin repository.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:

    • Download the plugin zip file.
    • Go to the WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Select the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.

  2. Activate the Plugin:

    • Once installed, click on the Activate button to enable the plugin.

  3. Configure Settings (if applicable):

    • No additional configuration is required, but feel free to adjust the WebP quality in the code if needed.
